1.w: Hear now what YHWH is saying: “Arise, dispute with the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

2.w: Hear, O mountains, the dispute of YHWH, and you enduring foundations of the earth, for a dispute [is] unto YHWH against His people, and He will argue against Israel.

3.w: ‘My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? Answer Me!

4.w: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery; I redeemed you and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

5.w: My people, remember, please, what Balak king of Moab counseled, and what Balaam son of Beor answered him—from Shittim unto Gilgal, so that you may know the righteous acts of YHWH!’”

6.w: With what will I come before YHWH [and] bow myself before God Most High? Will I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves, sons of a year?

7.w: Will YHWH be pleased with thousands of rams, with myriad rivers of oil? Will I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body [for] the sin of my soul?

8.w: He has shown to you, O man, what [is] good. And what does YHWH seek from you, but to do justice and to love kindness, and to be humble to walk with your God?

9.w: The voice of YHWH calls to the city, and wisdom fears Your name: “Heed the rod, and the One who has appointed it!

10.w: Are there Yet, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness, and the ephah of leanness, which is accursed?

11.w: Shall I count pure one with scales of wickedness, and with a bag of weights of deceit?

12.w: How her rich men are full of violence, and her dwellers have spoken deception, and their tongue [is] deceitful in their mouth!

13.w: So also I will be severe in striking you, to make [you] desolate over your sins!

14.w: You will eat, and you will not be satisfied, your emptiness [is] in your entrails; you will put away, and you will not save, and what you save, I will give to the sword.

15.w: You will sow, and you will not reap; you will tread the olives, and you will not anoint yourselves with oil, and new wine, and you will not drink the wine.

16.w: And the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you⁺ walk by their counsels. Therefore I will give you to desolation, and your dwellers to hissing, and you⁺ will bear the scorn of the nations.”
